Courage, Compassion, Joy
Durweston
I am delighted that you are interested in our lovely school.
We are very proud of what we do here. As a small village school, we believe we get to know all of our children as individuals and strive to bring out the best in each of them. We have high expectations of work and behaviour but, as well as working hard, we make sure our children have fun too. Our vision is to 'Feed the mind, nurture the spirit and free the imagination.' By offering the richest curriculum that we can, and inspiring a commitment to our values of courage, compassion and joy, we hope to ensure that our children are well prepared for whatever happens in their lives when they leave us.

We really do have a talented bunch of children at Durweston and to see them all perform over the last few days has been a privilege! 'Go for Gold' our 2026 production really didn't disappoint. The singing, the dancing, the costumes and the line delivery all brought it together in incredible fashion! Well done all from Seahorses, Sharks and Porpoises - children and staff, fantastic Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust #dorsetschools
Today has been quite the day! To be invited to greet the King and Queen on their visit to Blandford today was quite extraordinary. The 3 that were selected did us proud and represented us beautifully! They were able to shake hands and talk with their Royal Hignesses and thanks to 2 parents that gifted beautiful posies of flowers to present. The quote from the queen was 'wow look at these, absolutely stunning' so it made it really special thank you! It was extremely hot but being amongst the Blandford Schools Network was really special! Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust
Today was a real special day! Our Leavers are enjoyed the leavers breakfast put on by the church coffee shop and it really was spectacular. The tablescape was so special and really made the event memorable and special! Thank you to all involved - how are they really going to be leaving us so soon! Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust
Today we had such fun in the sun during our morning Sports Day! Things had to look a little different in the sun but the children did amazingly! A huge shout out to Mrs DeSilva who organised this event and all the staff involved for their amazing commitment to making it a wonderful day! Thank you too for the ice lollies PTA they were very much appreciated! Can I also just do a shout out to Grant Smith who has been such a support to our school this year and who goes above and beyond at every opportunity to support in setting up, down and all the bits in between - we really are grateful! Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust #sportsday #dorsetschools Durweston Pre-School
A snippet from every class today during our Transition Day. The children came in beautifully and are all enjoying having a 'day in the life' of their new classes. Every class has such a calm, wonderful feel and lots of smiling faces which is always the best news to share!
We wanted to share exciting news this morning, we have 4 chicks arrived who look absolutely beautiful and very cute! We will share with the children so they all get a chance to meet them
A little snippet showing some of the amazing photos taken by Alan Wicks! He's really captured the joy that was displayed and the enjoyment that everyone experienced. A huge thank you to the PTA and the incredible volunteers who made this event happen! We will share more of the photos soon Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust
Great football event Spetisbury CE Primary today for our Year 5/6 children to enjoy some time together in a friendly competition. Well done to Spetisbury teams who were fantastic and won the games - this time round! I think the photos do just highlight how happy children can be with the simplest of things. Got to love a tyre!
Wow what a day! Seahorses and Dolphins adventured out today on their trip to Moors Valley! It was so nice that the children had times to themselves and times together and they definitely arrived back to school this afternoon buzzing which was so lovely! Thank you to all the adults who made it possible. And well done everyone for the early start this morning! #schooltrips #dorset Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust
Don't forget next week our amazing PTA are putting on the annual event of the colour run! They are crying out for helpers to set up, pack away and help run the event so please can I put a plea out to speak to Jemma, Mel or Chris from the PTA to discuss details and offer your assistance - we'd all be very grateful.
A wonderful leavers service with Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust today for our Year 6 leavers. A wonderful special way to say goodbye to all the leavers in our family of schools. It was a rainy one but once again beautiful organisation and a lovely atmosphere! #year6 #leavers #dorset
Today you'd have spotted our Year 6's somewhere up a cliff, on a beautiful coastal walk, playing games on the beach or if your eyes will let you believe it having some down time reading! What a joy to hear and see what they are all getting up to. Pushing themselves, getting over their fears and building relationships together! Go team Durweston

Governance
Trustees
You can find full information about our Trustees by clicking on this link.
As the name suggests, an ASEC works with the leadership of the school to monitor the standards and ethos in the school, as well as safeguarding and health and safety. The Chair of each ASEC will support the development of individual ASEC members and the clerk and, in turn, will work with the clerk to carry out a 360-degree review of their own performance. Each ASEC should carry out an annual assessment of its performance in line with the self-evaluation questions found at the bottom of this page.
Please find in the Scheme of Delegation below, details of how the Trust Board is structured, including the names, categories, responsibilities and terms of appointment for each Director. The information provided includes a Register of Interests. Details of Academy Standards and Ethos Committees can be found on individual academy websites and the 'Get Information About Schools' website.
The Trust Board's register of interest is below. The register of interests for each ASEC is held by each school and should be published on their website.
The Board of Trustees for the Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust has five scheduled meetings per year, including one strategy day.
The Board has also appointed committees which meet three times per year: the Audit and Risk Committee, the Stewardship Committee, and the Trust Standards and Ethos Committee.
Minutes are held by the Business Support Administrator in the DSAT Services office.

Governance
Our Academy Ethos and Standards Committee (ASEC)
The governors and members of the Durweston ASEC, aim to serve our community by providing an education of the highest quality within the context of Christian belief and practice. We encourage an understanding of the meaning and significance of faith and promote Christian values through the experiences the school offers to all its pupils.
The Academy is part of the Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust. The Trust Board oversees all schools in the Trust. To ensure the Board maintains effective oversight of educational performance for the benefit of children, the Trust Board has delegated responsibility to Academy Standards and Ethos Committees for driving educational improvement via the monitoring and evaluation of educational performance against the Academy Improvement Plan (AIP), provision of challenge as well as support to hold school leaders to account for academy standards; pupil outcomes (especially for disadvantaged children), spirituality and wellbeing; stakeholder engagement and regulatory compliance i.e. safeguarding, H&S, SEND.
You can find out more about the Trust Board by clicking here.
You can also view the ASEC responsibilities via the DSAT Scheme of Delegation by clicking here.
We provide strategic leadership and accountability. It is governors who hold the main responsibility for finance in schools, and it is governors who work with the Headteacher to make the tough decisions about balancing resources. We are also responsible for monitoring academic standards and for maintaining the vision and Christian ethos of the school. Governors appoint the Headteacher.
We meet six times a year. Minutes of our meetings may be obtained from the Clerk or the school office.

If you have any questions about your child’s needs, please contact our SENDCO, either by ringing the school office on 01258 452277 or emailing office@durweston.dsat.org.uk
